prompt: Objective: help a meal-kit company double revenue. What you've learned: the customer count is flat because new sign-ups equal cancellations. Latest finding: half of new customers cancel within two months. What is the best next step?

options.text: Work out why new customers cancel within two months
options.feedback: Right. Cancellations cancel out every new customer, so early churn comes before spending more on acquisition.

options.text: Calculate the marketing needed to double sign-ups
options.feedback: More sign-ups won't help while half of them leave within two months.

options.text: Compare prices with rival meal-kit companies
options.feedback: Price may turn out to be one reason people cancel, but start with why they cancel.

options.text: Size the market for ready-to-eat meals
options.feedback: A new product is a later lever. The finding is about churn.

explanation: Half of new customers cancel within two months, so understanding early churn comes before growing acquisition.
